tools.name: auc
tools.tagline: score an ink map against a segment's published labels
tools.summary: `python -m kit auc` gives the pixel AUC of a 2D ink map against a segment's `inklabels.zarr` inside its `supervision.zarr`, with the reverse-depth map as the control, block-bootstrap intervals, and a paired test of whether one map beats another.

go_ahead.text: Not needed

fields.Run: `python -m kit auc`, `from kit import auc`
fields.Needs: Python 3.10 or newer, numpy, tifffile (imagecodecs for LZW or zstd TIFFs), zarr (3.x on Python 3.11 or newer; 2.x works for reading)
fields.Runs on: Any CPU. A full-size 5,980 x 8,240 map takes about 5 s with a control and about 6 s with `--bootstrap 300` (measured 2026-10-16, 4-core 2.1 GHz Xeon cloud container, synthetic data)
fields.Network: None
fields.Writes: Nothing (prints only). With `--slug SLUG`, appends one check to `experiments/SLUG/run.json` (or `ROOT/SLUG/run.json` with `--root`)
fields.Go-ahead: Not needed
fields.Released: Public `main` since 2026-10-07; also inside the AutoPipeline release
fields.Guide: [STANDARDS.md](../STANDARDS.md) (how AUC is used here), [the overlap and baseline log](../logs/2026-10-07-overlap-and-baseline.md) (sampling noise)

tools.name: batch
tools.tagline: plan, price and queue AutoPipeline over every scan in the open-data bucket
tools.summary: `python -m kit run catalog`, `run all` and `run watch` list every volume of the Vesuvius Challenge open-data bucket, give each one an AutoPipeline config and a Modal price, and queue them in a resumable, approvable dry-run plan; they never launch anything.

go_ahead.text: Not needed for `catalog`, `watch`, `--dry-run` or `--status`: they launch, post and spend nothing. Needed for `--approve`: run it only with the digest Chase approved, and each approved scan's Modal launch needs his yes and budget (the go-ahead rule, hard rule 8)

fields.Run: `python -m kit run all`, `python -m kit run watch`, `python -m kit run catalog`, `from kit import autobatch, scancatalog`
fields.Needs: Python 3.10 or newer, standard library only. Reads `kit/data/modal-rates.json` (through [cloudcost](cloudcost.md)) and the prizes snapshot `kit/data/prizes-2026-10-11.json`. Launching an approved scan needs the released AutoPipeline package (`scrolls-kit`), which this tool does not call
fields.Runs on: Any CPU. A dry run of a 5-volume synthetic catalog took 0.19 s (measured 2026-10-16, cloud container). A catalog of the real bucket: Not measured; it is a few hundred small HTTPS requests
fields.Network: `run catalog`, `run watch`, and `run all` with `--refresh` or with no saved catalog: anonymous HTTPS GETs of `https://vesuvius-challenge-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com/metadata.json`, the bucket's S3 listing (root and each `SAMPLE/volumes/`) and `https://scrollprize.org/prizes` (skipped by `run catalog --no-live-prizes`). `run all` and `run watch` also GET each in-bucket volume's `.zattrs`, and `0/.zarray` when the shape is missing, once (cached). `dl.ash2txt.org` is refused. Nothing is posted
fields.Writes: `run catalog`: `--out` only (default `work/autobatch/catalog.json`). `run all` and `run watch`: under `--state` (default `work/autobatch/`, git-ignored): `catalog.json`, `plan.json`, `plan.md`, `batch-ledger.csv`, `approval.json`, `scans/SAMPLE/VOLUME/status.json` and `settings.json`, `zattrs/` caches. `run all --status` writes nothing
fields.Go-ahead: Not needed for `catalog`, `watch`, `--dry-run` or `--status`: they launch, post and spend nothing. Needed for `--approve`: run it only with the digest Chase approved, and each approved scan's Modal launch needs his yes and budget (the go-ahead rule, hard rule 8)
fields.Released: Public `main` since 2026-10-16 ([PR #93](https://github.com/ChaseHendrick/Scrolls/pull/93))
